stages.effectText: Increases SP recovery rate by +0.25/second while above 80% HP

Each attack will randomly trigger one of the following effects: Restores own HP by 18%, that attack deals 160% damage, Slows the enemy for 1.5 seconds, or Stuns the enemy for 1.1 seconds; additionally has a 20% chance to activate all the above effects at once.

Each attack will randomly trigger one of the following effects: Restores own HP by 20%, that attack deals 165% damage, Slows the enemy for 1.6 seconds, or Stuns the enemy for 1.2 seconds; additionally has a 30% chance to activate all the above effects at once.
Increases healing effects on this unit by 20%. Upon deployment, immediately restores the HP of an operator within attack range equal to 100% ATK.
Increases healing effects on this unit by 25% . Upon deployment, immediately restores the HP of an operator within attack range equal to 150% ATK.
